description: Pre-built AI workflow templates for e-commerce businesses

workflows.name: Order Status Auto-Response
workflows.description: Connect Shopify order data to support tool — auto-respond to WISMO queries
steps: Pull order status from Shopify API using order ID or email
Format tracking info into customer-friendly response
Auto-reply via support tool API or email
Log interaction for CS team visibility
prerequisites: Support tool with API (Gorgias, Zendesk, or email)

workflows.name: Smart Inventory Alert & Reorder
workflows.description: Monitor stock levels and trigger reorder workflows when thresholds are hit
workflows.trigger: Stock level drops below threshold for any SKU
steps: Monitor Shopify inventory levels via API polling
Detect SKUs below reorder threshold
Calculate optimal reorder quantity from sales velocity
Send reorder request to supplier or alert to Slack
Update inventory forecast dashboard

workflows.name: Automated Return Processing
workflows.description: Customer submits return → AI evaluates policy → auto-approve or flag for review
steps: Parse return request details (order ID, reason, condition)
Check against return policy rules (timeframe, condition, value)
Auto-approve returns that meet policy criteria
Generate return shipping label via shipping provider API
Send customer confirmation with label and instructions
Flag edge cases for human review

workflows.name: AI-Personalized Cart Recovery
workflows.description: Detect abandoned carts and send personalized recovery messages based on browsing context
steps: Detect abandoned cart events from Shopify webhooks
Analyze cart contents and customer browsing history
Generate personalized recovery message with Claude
Send via email (Klaviyo/Omnisend API) or SMS
Track recovery rate and optimize messaging
prerequisites: Email or SMS tool with API

workflows.name: Automated Review Response
workflows.description: Monitor new reviews and draft personalized responses for owner approval
steps: Monitor review platforms for new reviews via API or webhook
Analyze sentiment and extract key themes
Draft personalized response matching brand voice
Route to owner for quick approval or auto-post for positive reviews
Flag negative reviews for priority human response
prerequisites: Review platform with API (Google Business, Trustpilot, or Shopify reviews)
